# aris-ui

> A modern C++20 immediate-mode UI toolkit for OpenGL overlay injection:
> SDF-rendered widgets, MSDF font atlases, Yoga flexbox layout, and a
> headless preview/test toolchain designed for AI coding agents.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](./getting-started.html): Getting Started documentation for aris-ui
- [Core Concepts](./core-concepts.html): Core Concepts documentation for aris-ui
- [Widgets](./widgets.html): Widgets documentation for aris-ui
- [Layout](./layout.html): Layout documentation for aris-ui
- [Rendering](./rendering.html): Rendering documentation for aris-ui
- [Fonts](./fonts.html): Fonts documentation for aris-ui
- [Agent Tooling](./agent-tooling.html): Agent Tooling documentation for aris-ui
